mapper.sql: es.*, c.course_code as courseCode, c.course_name as courseName, c.term as term, t.teacher_name as teacherName, r.room_name as roomName
from exam_schedule es join course c on es.course_id = c.id left join teacher t on c.teacher_id = t.teacher_id left join room r on es.room_id = r.id
mapper.update:
update exam_schedule
course_id = #{courseId},
exam_type = #{examType},
exam_time = #{examTime},
duration_minutes = #{durationMinutes},
room_id = #{roomId}, seat_range = #{seatRange}, invigilator = #{invigilator}, remark = #{remark},
status = #{status},
where id = #{id}
